name: an empty record leaves everything to find
a course in progress is not done, and covers the rest only if it passes
one course counts in every requirement that names it, and each says so
hours are summed exactly, and a course with no hours counts as a course and as none
a key the audit cannot read is listed and not counted, never guessed at
a failed course is not counted and a retake is its own course; a repeat that passed twice counts twice
a minimum grade is read in the order the school wrote its grades
